name: finch-financial
description: Internal operations console for a fictional neobank. Built for a Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workshop.

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:migrate -w api && npm run seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
